development.instruction: Not a Cartesian grid. Pilot, choose a stable region on 2023, freeze, then inspect 2024. Temporal coupling only after identity validation.

acceptance.selection: Pareto comparison: feature separation, topology, seed and parameter stability, held-out utility; no arbitrary scalar average of ICVI.
acceptance.temporal: Must reduce spurious churn AND preserve planted shifts compared with zero coupling and frozen partition.
acceptance.utility: Peers selected from pre-cutoff features should have concordant held-out changes compared with region/level/random controls. Later peer outcomes are observed only for assessment: retrospective concordance, NOT forecasting. Common cohort, no self-neighbors, paired municipality bootstrap.
acceptance.stop: If graph gives no reproducible added value, keep simpler economic analogs plus the required attributed network; report conditional typology, not natural classes.
